description: Review of all 80 test files (2026-10-13, five parallel readers, key claims re-checked). Exact duplicates are few (~15); the larger problem is drift: one temp-module compile helper under five names in ~25 files, codes/whats/kernel_c/i64s/f64s/wait_until copied across 4-17 files, ~22 files hand-roll forced yields instead of assert_agrees(forced_yields: true). mix ci does not catch it: ex_dna scans lib/ only (on test/ it finds 26 clones), its min mass (30) misses small helpers, and no tool sees semantic duplicates.
title: [EPIC] Test suite drift: duplicated tests, copied helpers, and a CI gate
